tool.name: Focaloop VariationLoop
tool.description: adaptive CRAM range surveillance, host-depleted pathogen streaming, and diploid human variant calling
tool.command: focaloop variationloop --analysis-mode '$analysis_mode.mode' #if str($analysis_mode.mode) == "focused_cram" #if str($analysis_mode.input_source.source_type) == "manifest" --manifest '$analysis_mode.input_source.manifest' #else --bam '$analysis_mode.input_source.bam' #if $analysis_mode.input_source.crai --crai '$analysis_mode.input_source.crai' #end if --sample-name '$analysis_mode.input_source.sample_name' #end if #if $analysis_mode.ref_fasta --ref-fasta '$analysis_mode.ref_fasta' #end if #if $analysis_mode.targets_bed --targets-bed '$analysis_mode.targets_bed' #end if --cram-pad-bp $analysis_mode.cram_pad_bp --streams $analysis_mode.streams #elif str($analysis_mode.mode) == "wgs_stream" #if str($analysis_mode.input_source.source_type) == "manifest" --manifest '$analysis_mode.input_source.manifest' #if $analysis_mode.input_source.reads --reads #for $r in $analysis_mode.input_source.reads '$r' #end for --read-ids #for $r in $analysis_mode.input_source.reads '${r.element_identifier}' #end for #end if #else --reads-r1 '$analysis_mode.input_source.reads_r1' --reads-r2 '$analysis_mode.input_source.reads_r2' --sample-name '$analysis_mode.input_source.sample_name' #end if #if $analysis_mode.ref_fasta --ref-fasta '$analysis_mode.ref_fasta' #end if #if $analysis_mode.targets_bed --targets-bed '$analysis_mode.targets_bed' #end if --target-depth $analysis_mode.target_depth $analysis_mode.host_depletion --mapper '$analysis_mode.mapper' #else #if str($analysis_mode.input_source.source_type) == "history_fq" --reads-r1 '$analysis_mode.input_source.reads_r1' --reads-r2 '$analysis_mode.input_source.reads_r2' --sample-name '$analysis_mode.input_source.sample_name' #elif str($analysis_mode.input_source.source_type) == "history_bam" --bam '$analysis_mode.input_source.bam' #if $analysis_mode.input_source.crai --crai '$analysis_mode.input_source.crai' #end if --sample-name '$analysis_mode.input_source.sample_name' #else --manifest '$analysis_mode.input_source.manifest' #if $analysis_mode.input_source.reads --reads #for $r in $analysis_mode.input_source.reads '$r' #end for --read-ids #for $r in $analysis_mode.input_source.reads '${r.element_identifier}' #end for #end if #end if --ref-fasta '$analysis_mode.ref_fasta' #if $analysis_mode.targets_bed --targets-bed '$analysis_mode.targets_bed' #end if --mapper '$analysis_mode.mapper' --subsample-fraction $analysis_mode.subsample_fraction #end if $calling_options.reassembly --min-mapq $calling_options.min_mapq --min-bq $calling_options.min_bq --snv-min-qual $calling_options.snv_min_qual --indel-min-qual $calling_options.indel_min_qual --dedup-bits $calling_options.dedup_bits --sample-timeout $calling_options.sample_timeout @THREADS@ --state-dir variationloop_state_dir --state-archive '$variationloop_state' --out-variants '$variants_summary' --out-vcf '$variants_vcf' #if str($analysis_mode.mode) in ("focused_cram", "wgs_stream") and str($analysis_mode.emit_drm) == "true" --out-drm '$drm_calls' #end if --out-report '$variationloop_report'

tool.help:
**What It Does**
**Focaloop VariationLoop** performs byte-budgeted, memory-bounded variant calling, drug-resistance surveillance, and diploid genotyping directly from Galaxy History files (FASTQ, BAM, CRAM) or remote INSDC/CRAM archives without materializing full multi-gigabyte intermediate alignments.
-----
**Mode Selection Guide**
Choose the analysis mode matching your biological question and data source:
- **Focused CRAM range surveillance (`focused_cram`)**: Reads only the `.crai` container index and fetches the byte ranges overlapping either the 55 curated *Plasmodium falciparum* drug-resistance/CNV/*hrp2/3* barcode windows (when using the bundled Pf3D7 reference) or your custom BED intervals. Ideal for large remote CRAM surveillance cohorts (~20 MB transferred per 1.5 GB CRAM) or targeted clinical panels. - **Pathogen WGS adaptive streaming with host depletion (`wgs_stream`)**: Streams raw INSDC (`ERR`/`SRR`) runs, HTTP FASTQ URLs, or History FASTQs through an inline C 31-mer / PLA host-depletion filter that strips host/off-target reads in memory before mapping, halting automatically once the adaptive stop gate reaches target core depth and breadth stability. - **Diploid human / eukaryotic VariationLoop (`diploid_wgs`)**: Runs a lock-free contig-sharded and 64 kb lazy-paged C pileup accumulator (`PagedContigAccumulator`), 62-bit coordinate+insert-length PCR duplicate filter, Beta-Binomial overdispersed diploid SNV/indel genotyper (`0/0`, `0/1`, `1/1`, `1/2`, spanning-deletion aware), and multi-k (`k=31`, `k=55`) Simple Omnitig + C semi-global Phred haplotype active-region reassembler.
-----
**Manifest & Input Requirements**
For single-sample History runs, select **Single Galaxy History CRAM/BAM** or **Galaxy History paired-end FASTQ(.gz)** directly.
For multi-sample or remote streaming cohorts, provide a tab-separated (TSV) or comma-separated (CSV) manifest with a header row:
**Mode A (`focused_cram`) manifest columns:**
``` sample_id country_or_group source_uri_or_srr crai_uri population PH1387-C Cambodia https://example.org/cram/PH1387-C.cram https://example.org/cram/PH1387-C.cram.crai AS-SE-E PF1002-C Ghana https://example.org/cram/PF1002-C.cram https://example.org/cram/PF1002-C.cram.crai AF-W ```
**Mode B (`wgs_stream`) manifest columns:**
``` sample_id country_or_group source_uri_or_srr population ERR123456 Ghana ERR123456 AF-W sample_local Mali sample_local AF-W ```
- `source_uri_or_srr`: INSDC accession (`ERR...`/`SRR...`/`DRR...`), HTTP(S) FASTQ URL (pair separated by `;`), or the matching Galaxy History FASTQ element identifier when attaching History reads.
**Mode C (`diploid_wgs`) manifest columns:**
``` sample_id country_or_group source_uri_or_srr mate2_url crai_uri HG002 GIAB https://example.org/HG002_R1.fastq.gz https://example.org/HG002_R2.fastq.gz ```
-----
**Parameter Guide**
- **Reference genome FASTA (`--ref-fasta`)**: Optional in pathogen surveillance modes when analyzing *P. falciparum* (defaults to bundled PlasmoDB-54 Pf3D7); required for diploid human/eukaryotic calling and custom references. - **Custom target regions BED (`--targets-bed`)**: Optional 0-based BED intervals restricting calling, target 31-mer baiting, or CRAM container range selection. - **Target median core depth (`--target-depth`)**: Mode B adaptive stop-gate target (default `24.0x`). - **Host depletion filter (`--host-depletion`)**: Enables on-the-fly C 31-mer / PLA filtering of host or off-target spots in Mode B. - **Short-read aligner (`--mapper`)**: `Auto` probes candidate mappers (`strobealign`, `minimap2`, `bwa-mem2`, `bwa`) at runtime and selects the fastest working binary. - **Multi-k Simple Omnitig reassembly (`--reassembly`)**: Reassembles active regions around indels, soft-clips, and clustered variants (`k=31` escalating to `k=55` across tandem repeats) and scores haplotypes with exact Phred-weighted semi-global alignment. - **PCR duplicate filter table size (`--dedup-bits`)**: Log2 slots per shard (`20` = ~8 Mb/shard for panels/pathogens; set to `24` for 35x human WGS).
-----
**Outputs**
1. **`variants.vcf`**: Standard VCFv4.2 variant calls (`GT:GQ:DP:AD` in diploid mode; `GT:DP:AD:WSAF` in pathogen mode). 2. **`variants_summary.tsv`**: Tab-separated summary of all variant calls (`sample_id`, `chrom`, `pos`, `ref`, `alt`, `kind`, `gt`, `dp`, `ad_ref`, `ad_alt`, `qual`). 3. **`drm_calls.tsv`** *(pathogen modes when enabled)*: Per-isolate WHO antimalarial resistance classifications, `kelch13` / `crt` / `dhfr` / `dhps` / `mdr1` genotypes, CNV calls (`mdr1`, `pm2_pm3`, `gch1`, `crt`), *hrp2/3* deletions, and within-host clonality ($F_{WS}$). 4. **`variationloop_report.html`**: Self-contained interactive HTML report summarizing per-sample streaming telemetry, host depletion statistics, variant counts, and cohort prevalence. 5. **`variationloop_state.focaloop.tar.zst`**: Compressed warm-state archive for zero-new-byte follow-up contrasts and $F_{ST}$ queries in **Focaloop Query**.
-----
**Citations**
- MalariaGEN *Pf8* & *P. falciparum* drug-resistance surveillance (`doi:10.12688/wellcomeopenres.18681.1`). - Rahman & Medvedev (2022), *Simple Omnitigs*; Sun & Medvedev (2019), *VarGeno*.
